business_problem: Demandbase needed to automate B2B campaign execution, speed creative production, and give advertisers more direct access to performance insights without depending on slow manual handoffs to customer-success teams.
solution_summary: Demandbase expanded its account-based advertising platform on Google Cloud by combining BigQuery with generative creative and embedded analytics. BigQuery serves as the warehouse for AI and reporting workloads across the DSP. On top of that data layer, the company built a Creative Suite with Gemini 2.5, Imagen 3, and Gemini platform so B2B advertisers can generate personalized assets in minutes or seconds instead of months of manual production. JourneyIQ automates full-funnel optimization by adjusting targeting, creative, and budgets based on an account's real-time stage. For measurement, Looker Embedded Analytics and Looker's semantic model are integrated with Gemini so customers can ask natural-language questions about spend, performance, and ROI inside the product. The architecture ties data warehousing, content generation, optimization, and conversational analytics into one advertiser-facing system.

data_flow: Advertiser and campaign data lands in BigQuery, where JourneyIQ and other platform services use it to optimize budgets, targeting, and creative. Gemini 2.5 and Imagen 3 generate campaign assets, while Looker Embedded Analytics and Gemini expose campaign results and ROI in a natural-language interface inside the DSP.
